chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Whoever dies in one of the two sanctuaries will be safe from the greatest terror on the Day of Resurrection."

key_terms.الْحَرَمَيْنِ: the two sacred sanctuaries, referring to Makkah and Madinah
key_terms.الْفَزَعِ الْأَكْبَرِ: the greatest terror or supreme dread of the Hereafter
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection, when humanity is raised for judgment

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for someone who dies in one of the two sanctuaries?
ai.summary: This hadith states that one who dies in one of the two sacred sanctuaries is granted safety from the greatest terror on the Day of Resurrection. It highlights the spiritual distinction of the two harams and connects place of death with eschatological security.
